title: The Guard Steps Aside
setup: White has just pulled its rook off the open c-file to b1, and its king has no square left.
hint: Two knight jumps give check from the corner side; only one of them is out of reach of a pawn.
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook left c1 and stopped covering c2. {{Nc2#}} checks a king whose three neighbors, a2, b2 and b1, are all its own pieces, and no white piece watches c2. The other check, {{Nb3+}}, dies to axb3. Smothered mate lives in every corner, not just h8.
